page.notes: Printed "subjectus" and the other long s forms are copied as plain s. The page number "51" after "p." is read from a small figure and may be "5l"; the reading 51 is my best reading. The word "Walæus" is set with a ligature and is read as Walæus. The last line is "subor-" with "dinatos" right-aligned; the hyphen is kept. The line "dinatos" appears on its own line at the right, so it is the end of the visible text on this page. The page is typeset in roman and italic, with no black letter and no Greek or Hebrew.
